_comment: The application commit this workflow is approved to deploy.
A 40-hex app_sha input establishes SYNTAX, not approval. Every commit on
every branch is 40 hex characters. This file is the approval, it lives on
the default branch, and changing it is a reviewed change.
The candidate checkout never supplies its own approval: this file is read
from the operational checkout (the commit the workflow itself ran from),
never from the application commit under deployment.
Future acceptances are a one-line edit here, reviewed like any other.

_twelveTransportNote: SUPERSEDED READING, CORRECTED HERE. An earlier version of this note said twelve services (wsfeventcontext, wsfjointurnline, wsfturnready, wsfmyturn, wsfcompletemyturn, wsfleaveturnline, wsfcreatecombinedgoal, wsfclosecombinedgoal, wsfrepaircombinedgoal, wsfapprovestation, wsfliststations, wsfrevokestation) remained invoker_iam_check_enabled, citing run 35450108207, and concluded the expo queue path was unusable. That is WRONG as of the later run 35474881609 (run 32, 2026-09-19T23:06:35Z), whose verify receipt reads every one of those twelve as invoker_iam_check_disabled, alongside PREEXISTING_TRANSPORT_VERIFIED=22/22, NEW_SERVICE_TRANSPORT=invoker_iam_check_disabled and VERIFY=pass. The transports are open. Read from that run's own log, not carried over from a review. WHAT RUN 32 ALSO EXERCISED, which is a separate and stronger fact than transport: eight of those twelve answered at the application level in its 24-PASS turn row, called with synthetic members' own Firebase ID tokens - wsfEventContext, wsfJoinTurnLine, wsfLeaveTurnLine, wsfMyTurn, wsfTurnReady, wsfCompleteMyTurn, wsfCreateCombinedGoal and wsfApproveStation. THE OTHER FOUR ARE TRANSPORT-OPEN BUT UNEXERCISED: wsfCloseCombinedGoal, wsfRepairCombinedGoal, wsfListStations and wsfRevokeStation are not called by hosted-package-e-smoke.mjs at all, so no hosted run has established how they answer. SCOPE, AND THE LINE THIS NOTE MUST NOT CROSS: service-level acceptance is not the browser/player journey. It does not establish QR to retained activity/auth to phone-or-queue choice to ready/start to shared player to review/receipt to cleared station. That gate remains pending until 6b257c3 is actually served and one hosted player run passes. Nothing in this pin changes any transport, IAM binding or function code.
